description:
Let Your Body Rest | Slow Tanpura | 1.5 Hours to Ease Built-Up Stress

Your mind may have clocked off, but your body is still holding the day - in the shoulders, the jaw, the breath. Let it rest now.

This deep Indian tanpura drone is designed to slow your body down: one warm, continuous sound that loosens built-up stress until rest comes on its own.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of slow tanpura resonance with gentle harmonic swells, no drums, no melody to follow and no vocals.

▶ Keep resting — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:

Perfect for decompressing after work, stress relief, burnout recovery, lying on the floor, yoga nidra, a body scan, breathwork, a warm bath, reading, or the hour before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Tanpura (Indian drone instrument), solo
Raga: Kafi (a tender, warm raga)
Style: Indian classical drone, ambient
Mood: Heavy, warm, restful
Atmosphere: Lamplight, a mattress on the floor, the day set down
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Lie down, let your arms fall loose and breathe out longer than you breathe in. Move your attention slowly from your feet to your head and let each swell of the drone soften whatever it finds.
